method: IQ-TREE 2.3.6, fixed LG+G4, --fast search, SH-aLRT support (1000 replicates; values are SH-aLRT, not ultrafast bootstrap), seed 20261124; full-toxin trees use the columns occupied by >= 20 % of the entries; domain trees use the columns of the module, entries with >= 100 (DI, DII) or 70 (DIII) residues of it
rooting: stored unrooted; the page roots at the midpoint or on a chosen entry

frames.struct: Structure-based: FoldMason of the AlphaFold DB models of each module (N-term, DI, DII, DIII, C-term cut separately), the entries without an exact model added with MAFFT --add, segments joined
frames.seq: Sequence-based: MAFFT L-INS-i of N-term, DI, DII, DIII and C-term separately, joined (segments from the first-pass alignment)

name_order.method: UPGMA (average linkage) constrained to the Name order: only clusters that are neighbours in the Name list are joined; Kimura protein distances over the alignment columns occupied by >= 20 % of the entries
